title: reservoired-preemption-coordinator-and-soft-backfill-orchestrator
author: Nadia Vogel
description: Summary: Introduce a reservoir-based preemption coordinator that tracks per-tenant preemption credits and applies a soft-backfill orchestrator to opportunistically fill freed capacity while preserving latency SLAs. Motivation: Dedicated clusters occasionally experience noisy preemption cycles that spike P99 latency for latency-sensitive tenants. Existing hard-preempt logic causes oscillations and unjustified eviction of warm slots. Design overview: 1) Preemption reservoir: each tenant is allocated a credit reservoir (configurable via FleetConfig). Credits are deducted when we preempt warm slots for higher-priority work; credits replenish at a slow, configurable rate so aggressive preemption is rate-limited. 2) Coordinator: central controller that enforces reservoir caps, simulates the cost of preemption (estimated latency/regression risk) and only issues preemption instructions when credit budget allows or when absolute safety thresholds are crossed. 3) Soft-backfill orchestrator: when capacity frees, this component posts best-effort backfill requests to lower-priority queues in a controlled, latency-aware fashion (throttled by windowed acceptance). Backfill uses predictive headroom signals to avoid thrashing warm caches. 4) Telemetry and accounting: new metrics (tenant_preempt_credit_available, preempt_attempts, preempt_success_rate, backfill_fill_pct, backfill_rejection_rate) and trace spans for preempt decision path. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag fl_reservoir_preempt; staged rollout to 10% of Dedicated pools, monitor P50/P95/P99 and backfill success, expand to 100% over 7 days. Backout plan: disable flag -> coordinator stops issuing preemptions; drain outstanding backfill tickets. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4721) - [x] Feature flag and config schema - [x] Coordinator core logic + unit tests - [x] Soft-backfill controller + e2e load harness - [x] Telemetry & dashboard (console change PR follows) - [x] RBAC checks for coordinator actions - [x] Integration tests in perf-canary - [x] Manual cluster soak for 48h Testing notes: unit tests cover credit accounting edgecases; integration tests run synthetic noise tenants against latency-sensitive tenants; perf-canary run showed 12% reduction in preemption frequency and 4ms P99 improvement for critical tenants under mixed workloads. Backwards compatibility: default reservoir sizes are zero for existing tenants (no behavior change) unless FleetConfig is updated. Security/ops: coordinator requires new permission preempt:write; installer will add RBAC rule when feature toggled. Migration: migration is a lightweight config bump and creation of a new telemetry namespace. Why this is different from previous autoscalers: rather than only relying on headroom signals we incorporate a bounded credit accounting layer to prevent runaway preemption and to make soft backfills behave predictably.

review_comments: Ethan Li: Can we make the default reservoir size 0 to avoid accidental behavior changes? (author) Nadia: yes, default is 0 and docstring updated to make this explicit

Priya Desai: Please add a fallback path when credit store is unavailable so we don't block scaling decisions. Nadia: implemented a best-effort fallback that treats missing store as zero credits and emits a warning metric
Marco Silva: The replenishment rate seems aggressive in the proposal; can we parameterize per-tenant? Nadia: replenishment is per-tenant and uses min/max clamps; added unit tests for edgecases
Ops (comment): Ensure RBAC change is included in private-installer upgrade notes. Nadia: added k8s patch YAML and installer ticket in Linear ENG-4778
release_notes: Introduce a reservoir-based preemption coordinator and soft-backfill orchestrator behind a feature flag. Enables bounded preemption behavior and controlled best-effort backfill to reduce P99 latency spikes caused by aggressive eviction. Telemetry and RBAC additions included.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag fl_reservoir_preempt must be enabled per-cluster. Ensure role-preempt-patch.yaml is applied during installer upgrade. Watch metrics tenant_preempt_credit_available and backfill_fill_pct during rollout.
how_to_test: 1) Enable feature flag on a small dedicated pool. 2) Run e2e/perf/canary/reservoir_preempt_workload.yaml which launches mixed priority traffic. 3) Confirm preemption_attempts decrease and critical tenant P99 improves. 4) Verify backfill_rejection_rate stays below 5% in first 24h.
follow_up: Console dashboard PR to visualize tenant preempt credit and backfill fill percentage (will be submitted after SDK + API surface stabilizes). Also consider a user-facing API for tenants to opt into a non-preemptible mode (future work).
